reviews.title: Final Fantasy Resonance
reviews.review: so far I'm really liking this.  It's got some heavy FFIV vibes for it with the story, setting, setup, etc.  the HD2D here looks quite nice, and I can see it continuing to grow and expand as they add more titles to this.  I'm almost bummed that they didn't give this a full FF Number (FF XVII) and do something like they did for Dragon Quest XII when they moved a full numbered entry in that system to the 3DS.   I'll come back with more thoughts later...
